findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice short questions for Unit 1 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 65 questions numbered 1-65; by section: 1.1 2, 1.1.1 3, 1.1.2 4, 1.1.3 3, 1.1.4 5, 1.1.5 4, 1.2 3, 1.2.1 4, u-complex-polynomials-as-a-product-of-linear-factors 8, 1.3.1 4, 1.4 2, 1.4.1 5, 1.5 2, 1.5.1 2, u-polar-coordinates-system 2, 1.4.1~2 4, 1.3.3 4, u-complex-numbers-in-the-real-world-voltage-current-and-resist 4.

Covers Unit 1 in book order (1.1 to 1.7). Numbers and functions are changed from the book's examples and exercises; every answer and every intermediate step was checked by computation in Python (sympy). Book corrections followed: cube roots (-1 +/- sqrt(3) i)/2, r sin(theta) for the imaginary part, reactance for X_L, X_C.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
